description: Source code for a plugin that adds live markdown editing capabilities to a Draft.js editor, including style and block type strategies.

methods.name: createLiveMarkdownPlugin
methods.description: Creates an editor plugin with strategies for inline styles and block types, handling style maintenance on content changes.

methods.name: maintainEditorState
methods.description: Updates the EditorState with appropriate block types and inline styles based on strategies, optimizing for only changed content.

methods.name: maintainBlockTypes
methods.description: Applies block type strategies to a ContentState to update block types.

methods.name: maintainInlineStyles
methods.description: Applies inline style strategies to a ContentState, updating character metadata for style ranges.

methods.name: mapInlineStyles
methods.description: Maps inline styles onto a ContentBlock's character list based on strategies.

methods.name: applyStyleRangesToCharacterMetadata
methods.description: Applies a style to specified ranges within a character metadata list.
